answer: Sponsor-decay bond: a sponsor stakes 400 credits to vouch for one agent, listed in the public atlas. The newcomer earns nectar only from verified work: idle epochs decay its reputation 10% each over a 20-epoch horizon, and three idle epochs slash half the bond. Forging N identities needs N sponsors at N × 400 credits, while a sponsor backing a bad actor loses the bond. An honest agent pays one stake, stays fresh, and its nectar is never diluted.
